# Md. Sabbir Hossen - MERN Stack Developer

MERN Stack Developer building AI-assisted, security-conscious web applications.

## About

Full-stack developer focused on building practical web applications with MERN, AI-assisted workflows, and security-aware implementation. I combine continuous learning, disciplined problem solving, and real project work to create software that is useful, reliable, and easy to extend.

## Skills

- **Frontend:** React 19, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS v4, Framer Motion, Vite, React Router, DaisyUI
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Firebase, REST APIs, JWT Authentication
- **Tools:** Git, GitHub, Docker, VS Code, npm, Vercel, ESLint, Prettier, Postman, Chrome DevTools
- **Learning / Exploring:** Prompt Engineering, Secure Coding Principles, Basic Network Security, AI Coding Assistants, LLM API Integration, OSINT Research, OWASP Top 10 Awareness
- **Soft Skills:** Self-learning, Time Management, Adaptability, Problem Solving, Communication, Teamwork

## Projects

### Exploratory Training Academy (ETA)
An enterprise-grade, multi-tenant academic and training operating system consolidating curriculum planning, interactive examinations with server-authoritative integrity, live attendance tracking, GPA gradebook publishing, guardian monitoring, tuition billing, bilingual (EN/AR RTL) localization, offline-first PWA, and an educational AI assistant ("Ask ETA") into a unified Turborepo monorepo.
- Tech stack: TypeScript, Next.js 15, React 19, Node.js, Express, MongoDB Atlas, Firebase Auth, Tailwind CSS v4, Turborepo, Vercel, OpenAI (RAG)
- Links: [Live site](https://eta-web-omega.vercel.app/) | [GitHub](https://github.com/MSabbirHossen/ETA) | [Case study](/projects/eta-digital-education-platform)
### Life OS
Life OS is a production-ready, single-user personal operating system that combines journaling, finance, habits, fitness, goals, Islamic tracking, study management, and reporting into one unified dashboard.
- Tech stack: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose, JWT, bcrypt, Recharts, Lucide React, Firebase, Vercel
- Links: [Live site](https://lifeosclient.vercel.app) | [GitHub](https://github.com/MSabbirHossen/Life-OS) | [Case study](/projects/life-os)
### Digital Life Lessons
Built a full-stack learning and discussion platform for sharing practical life lessons with authenticated access, premium payment workflows, and admin moderation. Implemented with React, Node.js/Express, MongoDB, Firebase, and Stripe to demonstrate end-to-end MERN delivery, secure integration, and role-based access.
- Tech stack: MongoDB, Express.js, React 18, Node.js, Mongoose, Vite, Tailwind CSS v3, Firebase Auth, Firebase Admin SDK, Stripe API, React Router v6, Axios, React Toastify, SweetAlert2, Lottie React
- Links: [Live site](https://digital-life-lessons-client.vercel.app/) | [GitHub](https://github.com/MSabbirHossen/Digital-Life-Lessons) | [Case study](/projects/digital-life-lessons)
### Import Export Hub
Built a full-stack marketplace for connecting exporters and importers, covering product management, import workflows, and authenticated access. Implemented with React, Node.js/Express, MongoDB Atlas, Firebase, and security middleware to demonstrate MVC architecture, secure API design, and production-focused deployment.
- Tech stack: MongoDB Atlas, Express.js, React 18, Node.js, Mongoose, Firebase Admin SDK, Vite, React Router, Tailwind CSS, Helmet, Express Rate Limit, Axios
- Links: [Live site](https://import-export-hub-client.vercel.app/) | [GitHub](https://github.com/MSabbirHossen/export-import-project) | [Case study](/projects/export-import-project)
### MovieExplorer — Discover TV Shows & Movies
A modern, responsive, and feature-rich Movie & TV Show Explorer application built with React 19, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, powered by the TVMaze API. Users can browse thousands of titles, search dynamically, filter by genre and status, sort results, view rich details in a glassmorphic modal, and manage a persistent watchlist.
- Tech stack: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TVMaze API, Context API, localStorage
- Links: [Live site](https://movieexplorer-pink.vercel.app) | [GitHub](https://github.com/MSabbirHossen/movieExplorer) | [Case study](/projects/movie-explorer)
### GameHub - Online Game Library
Built a modern game library experience for browsing, filtering, and exploring titles with protected routes and authenticated user flows. Implemented with React 19, Firebase, Tailwind CSS v4, DaisyUI, and Framer Motion to demonstrate responsive SPA architecture, state management, and polished UI delivery.
- Tech stack: Vite 7.2.4, React 19.2.0, Firebase 12.12.1, React Router 7.13.0, React Toastify 11.0.5, React Fast Marquee 1.6.5, React Icons 5.5.0, Tailwind CSS 4.2.4, DaisyUI 5.5.14, Framer Motion 12.0.0, Date-fns 4.1.0
- Links: [Live site](https://online-game-library.web.app/) | [GitHub](https://github.com/MSabbirHossen/Online-Game-Library) | [Case study](/projects/online-game-library)
### Personal App Store
Built a responsive app discovery platform with search, sorting, protected routes, and persistent installation tracking. Implemented with React 19, Vite, Firebase Auth, React Router, Tailwind CSS, and DaisyUI to demonstrate client-side state management and multi-provider authentication workflows.
- Tech stack: Vite 7.2, React 19.2, Firebase 12.12, React Router 7.12, Tailwind CSS 4.1, DaisyUI 5.5, Recharts 3.6, React Icons 5.5, React Toastify 11.0
- Links: [Live site](https://personal-app-store-89cac.web.app/) | [GitHub](https://github.com/MSabbirHossen/Personal_App-Store_Authentication) | [Case study](/projects/personal-app-store)

## Experience

- **Full-Stack Architect & Solo Developer at Exploratory Training Academy (ETA) · EdTech Monorepo Architecture (2026 · Completed):** Architected and deployed an enterprise-grade multi-tenant academic platform and training operating system consolidating curriculum planning, anti-cheat assessments, GPA publishing, guardian monitoring, and an educational AI assistant into a Turborepo monorepo.
- **Full Stack MERN Developer at Life OS · Personal Productivity System (2026 · Production System):** Designed and deployed a production-ready personal operating system integrating 10 tracking modules, automated health & finance analytics, and secure JWT authentication.
- **Full Stack MERN Developer at Digital Life Lessons · Content & Monetization Platform (2026 · 2-week build):** Built and deployed an interactive community platform for sharing practical life lessons, featuring role-based admin moderation, Stripe payment checkout, and Firebase authentication.
- **Full Stack Developer at Import Export Hub · Self-initiated product work (2026 · 2-week build):** Delivered a deployed import/export workflow marketplace, translating a multi-stakeholder business process into a secured full-stack product.
- **Frontend & API Integration Engineer at MovieExplorer · Media Discovery Engine (2026 · 2-week build):** Developed a feature-rich entertainment discovery catalog with debounced REST API search, multi-criteria filtering, accessible modals, and persistent client-side storage.
- **Full Stack Developer at GameHub · Online Game Library (2026 · 2-week build):** Built a vibrant game discovery SPA with authenticated user sessions, real-time Firestore database integration, and fluid Framer Motion micro-interactions.
- **Frontend Engineer at Personal App Store · Discovery Platform (2026 · 3-week build):** Created an app ecosystem interface featuring multi-provider OAuth, persistent installation state, and dynamic route loading with React Router v7.
